concept_options.title: What If You Saw Who Wants You to Fail?
concept_options.why_this_works: The topic title from the 2026-11-12 slate (g-saw-who-wants-you-to-fail, 78/100, 3rd of 23); the writer's pick; pairs with thumbnail a (NOT HIM.)
concept_options.visual_approach: A cram-school street in Seoul at ten at night, towers of lit academy signboards behind (no lettering): you large at the left, mouth open, holding up the letter with the teal seal, eyes up at what just snapped open; your best friend Min-jun grinning, a fist up, reaching to hug you, a crimson split-flap meter over his head at -84%. Three candidates a, b, c differ only in the tag (NOT HIM., HE'S GLAD?, STILL HUGS.); drawn in code, brand/thumbs/envy
concept_options.hook: Ten o'clock, a Daechi-dong street: you hold up the letter that says you made the cut, your best friend grins and reaches for the hug, and over his head a paper meter snaps open and runs to minus eighty-four.
